sourceNote: Astral Radiance: Sword & Shield-era aggregate model, not a single primary study. Community box breakdowns (Deltia's Gaming, Coded Yellow, Bleeding Cool pull-rate quests, 10,000+-pack samples) converge on ~6-8 Pokémon V/VMAX, 1-3 alt/full arts, and 1-2 rainbow/gold secrets per 36-pack box. Mapped onto the three normalized tiers this set actually has: double_rare (plain V + Radiant) ~0.11/pack, ultra_rare (VMAX/VSTAR + Rare Ultra full/alt art) ~0.11/pack, hyper_rare (Rainbow + Secret) ~0.042/pack. Alt arts pull ~1:72, far below the flat ultra_rare rate, so a uniform tier average UNDERSTATES the headline chase (e.g. Moonbreon) rather than inflating it — deliberately conservative. Tier values are computed from live PriceCharting card prices, so per-set EV differences come from real card values, not the odds.
